projects.title: Course Resource Library
projects.description: Full-stack e-learning and digital library system with secure authentication, role-based access (admins & students), course and quiz management, and automated certificate generation using a three-tier REST architecture.
details: Built secure JWT authentication and RBAC from scratch.
Developed course and quiz creation, editing, and assignment logic.
Integrated automated certificate generation using dynamic templates.
Implemented scalable REST API architecture with Express and MongoDB.
Designed a modern, responsive React UI for students and admins.

projects.title: Face Recognition App using Clarifai API
projects.description: Real-time face detection tool using Clarifai API, achieving <1-second latency per image. Implemented secure JWT-based authentication and persisted 1,000+ search records with a responsive React frontend and Node/Express backend deployed on Heroku.
details: Integrated Clarifai API for real-time face detection.
Built user authentication with JWT and secure sessions.
Stored over 1,000+ search history logs in MongoDB.
Deployed the system on Heroku with a full CI/CD pipeline.
Implemented a responsive React UI with real-time detection feedback.

projects.title: Early Proactive Warning Systems (SDN)
projects.description: Deep learning model to detect unknown cyberattacks in network traffic, improving detection accuracy by 20% over traditional methods and achieving 94% classification accuracy on the NSL-KDD dataset using CNN and Linear Regression.
details: Built a CNN architecture to detect unknown cyberattacks.
Achieved 94% accuracy on the NSL-KDD dataset.
Outperformed traditional ML models by 20% improvement.
Used hybrid CNN + Linear Regression for higher precision.
Performed extensive data preprocessing using Pandas & NumPy.

projects.title: Disease Prediction using Machine Learning
projects.description: Machine learning app with 95% accuracy using NB, DT, RF, and KNN models with a GUI built using Tkinter.
details: Implemented 4 ML algorithms: NB, Decision Trees, Random Forest, KNN.
Designed and built a user-friendly Tkinter GUI for predictions.
Achieved 95% accuracy across multiple diseases.
Used Matplotlib for visualizing prediction patterns.
Processed structured and unstructured data using Pandas & NumPy.
